title: 炸裂、エル・スペシャル！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a petty argument between El Condor Pasa and Seeking the Pearl escalates into a wrestling showdown!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We may be doing this for fun, but as long as it's wrestling…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then I'm gonna go all out!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh! I certainly hope so! Now come… let's see how your skills hold up on the world stage!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course they do! One day, my name will be known the world over!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, this seems dangerous. You should quit before it's too late…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No way! I'll never turn down a challenge! I've got the blood of a fighter in me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ A big tackle like that isn't going to work on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl takes a big step back and avoids El Condor Pasa's attack! The audience's eyes are glued on the action.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… It's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… You can't touch this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl dodges another tackle from El Condor Pasa, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: (Ha! She's dodging with big steps to the outside. If I make a sharp dive from the inside…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa runs into a leap!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Take this! El Especiaaalll!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa steps swiftly behind Seeking the Pearl and puts her in an armlock.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Uncle! Uncle! I give up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! Victoria! My first victory with the El Especial!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What in the world are you all doing?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: El, I want to see you in the student council office later. Pearl, you can join us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa gets a rather stern lecture, but her movements have also developed a decisive edge from her match.
